station.provider: Agência Nacional de Águas e Saneamento Básico (ANA) / Serviço Geológico do Brasil (SGB)
station.series_identity: Emergency-gauge observations in the original, uncorrected vertical reference

access_review.authorization_status: Not requested or configured in ECHO
access_review.authorization_route: Request API access from hidro@ana.gov.br with the user's CPF or CNPJ, name, institution when applicable, and email address. ANA reviews the request and issues credentials if approved.
access_review.legacy_series_endpoint: Previously queried for the SAR interval; it returned explicit no-data XML responses for station 87444000 and corrected station 87450020. ANA documents this legacy service as superseded; its response does not establish that the archived emergency readings are absent.
access_review.public_inventory: Exact-code checks of the current inventory did not find station 87444000; an inventory miss does not establish absence from the historical archive.

interpretation_limits: The official report documents retention of the emergency-gauge series, but this screen did not retrieve or independently verify any measurement value.
An API authorization requirement is an access condition, not evidence that the series is unavailable or scientifically unsuitable.
Any retrieved point-gauge value would provide nearby hydrologic context only; it cannot establish water extent within the SAR AOI or validate SAR-derived change.
Do not combine station 87444000 with corrected station 87450020 without preserving their distinct series identities and vertical references.
Do not interpolate to SAR acquisition timestamps unless the source cadence, time reference, quality flags, and interpolation method are documented and justified.
